paragraphs.text:
Your host says, “It is bad to be here now, sir. A most dangerous 
object has come back to our land and an ancient curse will be 
fulfilled.” To try for more information, succeed with a Charm, 
Fast Talk, or Persuade roll and go to 200. Fail, and go to any 
Cairo location on the Egypt Location Table the next morning.
(198)
